quote: Sierpiński (1959) asked if this sequence is infinite
note: Sierpiński's 1959 question about whether noncototients form an infinite sequence is the earliest documented attribution for this problem. The conjecture that all noncototients are even (equivalent to asking if any odd noncototients exist) emerges from this line of inquiry.
